name: linklater
description: Linklater is an Instapaper-inspired “read it later” app.
author: Nick Schneble

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @linklater/api && npm run build --workspace @linklater/web
scripts.dev:test: node scripts/migrate-test-db.mjs && TESTING_UI=1 DATABASE_URL=$(node scripts/resolve-test-db-url.mjs) concurrently "npm run dev --workspace @linklater/api" "npm run dev --workspace @linklater/web"
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace @linklater/api && npm run format --workspace @linklater/web && npm run format:root
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @linklater/api && npm run lint --workspace @linklater/web && npm run lint:root && npm run lint:shell
scripts.lint:shell: command -v shellcheck > /dev/null || { echo 'ShellCheck is not installed, so the shell scripts cannot be linted. Install it with brew install shellcheck, or see https://www.shellcheck.net' >&2; exit 1; }; find bin scripts -type f -exec sh -c 'head -n 1 "$1" | grep -qE "^#!.*sh( |$)|^# shellcheck shell="' _ {} \; -print0 | xargs -0 shellcheck
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov --workspace @linklater/api && npm run test:cov --workspace @linklater/web && npm run test:root
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @linklater/api && npm run typecheck:test --workspace @linklater/web
